stage1.impression: A warm, well-composed deep view of a timber-and-concrete bar that looks like a good architectural visualisation rather than a photograph. The floor has hard, cookie-cutter chair shadows from a light no one can see, the concrete wall reads as cork or particle board, and the altar speakers, which should be the hero, are small, washed-out grey-white boxes with no tint. A magazine would not run it as a specific place yet: it reads as a generic moody bar, because the one thing that makes it Planet EARF, the tinted acrylic pair on the altar, doesn't register.

blocking_9: The altar pair must read at a glance as tinted, smoked cast acrylic with its light passing through, not as grey-white boxes (altar region lum_p95 <= 195, no near-neutral 150+ block)
No hard, sharp-edged furniture shadows on the floor from an unseen source; every shadow must trace to a visible practical
The board-formed concrete must show board grain, pour lines and tie holes at true scale, not a fine cork-like speckle
The Orb globes must glow, not read as white billiard balls (lum_median about 130 to 165)
The ceiling and fir must not be the frame's most saturated colour; the speakers must carry the colour
The altar must take up enough of the frame to be the subject (the speakers are now under 1 % of the frame)

defects.what: Left altar speaker blown to near-neutral grey-white (driver area RGB 157/149/145, p95 228); the smoke tint is lost and it looks like a white appliance; soft, smeared detail
Right altar speaker the same: washed out, no visible acrylic, edges and glow unreadable
Back-bar speaker in its niche reads as a grey hi-fi box with a greyed woofer, no tint or glow through the acrylic
Hard, crisp raking shadows of chairs and stools on the floor from a low source behind camera left (likely the street lamps); unmotivated and very CG
Orb table lamps read as opaque white balls (median lum 196, near-neutral); the frosted liner and tinted shell don't separate
Concrete wall has a uniform fine speckle like cork or chipboard, no formwork board grain; the wall is also the brightest large plane (median 75)
Screens show soft grey-purple smudges that read as unloaded textures or blurry prints
Ceiling beams heavily orange (median RGB 56/29/14), the most saturated colour in the frame; they read as one repeated wood texture
Diagonal haze streak from a pendant that reads as a stray light shaft
Many copies of the same stool and chair at identical angles; reads as instanced furniture
Banquette foreground goes muddy (median 20, crush 6.6 %), with little sign of life on the near tables

changes.problem: The altar spots blow the smoked speakers out to neutral grey-white, so the hero has no tint and no light through its acrylic.

evidence.measured: median lum 150.6, RGB 157/149/145 (near neutral), p95 249, clip 0.12 %

change.to: 70 W, 2500 K, cone 22 deg, aimed at the top third of each cabinet so the light passes through the acrylic and grazes down, not front-washes the driver baffle

changes.expected: The cabinets read as dark smoked acrylic with glowing edges and the white batts showing as a soft inner glow; the drivers sit in shadow-detail, not white.

changes.problem: The altar pair is tiny in the frame (each about 95 x 240 px of 2400 x 1600) and sits off the aisle axis, so the eye lands on the floor shadows and the Orbs first.

evidence.measured: both altar speakers together under 1 % of the frame

change.to: position [2.6, 2.6, 1.30], 35 mm, target [16.5, 3.0, 1.25], focus [12.0, 3.0, 1.2]: down the aisle between counter and tables, with the altar near the centre and the counter and banquette still framing it

changes.expected: The altar pair about 1.6 x larger, sitting on the vanishing point at the centre, with the counter and banquette as leading lines toward it.

changes.problem: Hard, sharp chair shadows rake across the floor from a small low source behind camera left with no visible practical.

evidence.measured: floor p95 177 against median 63, crisp shadow edges seen at 1:1

change.to: 2.0 W with a 0.4 m radius (soft), or off; let the Domes' downlights and Orbs make the pools on the floor

changes.expected: The floor falls off softly from the table pools, with no long hard silhouettes; the floor median drops to around 40 to 50.

changes.problem: The Orbs read as opaque white balls rather than tinted acrylic with a glowing frosted liner.
changes.expected: Each Orb shows a smoky shell around a softer liner glow and throws a warm pool on its tabletop; the globe median sits around 140 to 160.

changes.problem: The board-formed concrete reads as cork or chipboard: a fine uniform speckle with no board grain or pour lines, and it is the brightest big plane in the frame.

evidence.measured: median lum 74.8 (the frame's median is 35), fine noise only at 1:1

change.to: about 15 % darker base, a board-grain pattern at 150 mm board width with horizontal pour lines every 600 mm and tie holes on a 600 x 900 grid, faint vertical staining, roughness 0.75 with slight sheen variation; cut the speckle's scale and contrast by half

changes.expected: The wall reads as cast concrete at true scale and steps back behind the banquette, median about 50 to 60.

changes.problem: The fir ceiling is the most saturated colour in the frame, so it competes with the speakers as the colour note.

change.to: 3300 (and the oak or fir stain about 10 % less saturated)

changes.expected: The timber stays warm but reads as brown rather than orange; the speakers' tint becomes the only saturated note.

changes.problem: A diagonal haze streak from the third pendant reads as a stray light shaft cutting across the back wall.

evidence.measured: visible bright diagonal band against a dark timber wall

change.to: 0.0015 per metre (keep the Domes' downlights at 20 deg)

changes.expected: A faint atmosphere with no single beam that reads as an object.

changes.problem: The near tables and banquette are empty and muddy, so the foreground lacks a sign of life and repeats the same chair silhouettes.

evidence.measured: median lum 20.1, crush 6.6 %; one rocks glass on the nearest table

change.from: 1 rocks glass on the nearest table, chairs aligned
change.to: on the nearest table a half-drunk coupe, a napkin and a record sleeve; a coat over the nearest black chair; turn the foreground chairs 10 to 25 deg off their grid

changes.expected: A lived-in foreground that breaks the instanced look, with the Orb pool lifting the near banquette.

out_of_scope.request: Make the back-bar speakers in the niches read as tinted acrylic rather than grey boxes
out_of_scope.why: Their look is fixed as an EARF product; only the record wall and niche lighting may change. Lowering the niche strip (6.0) and the record-wall spots may help, but the cabinet itself is out of scope.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the blurry images on the screens with something crisper
out_of_scope.why: What the screens show is fixed by the room's design; only their brightness may change.

out_of_scope.request: Vary the identical stools and chairs
out_of_scope.why: The seats are fixed by the room's design; only their placement as set dressing can help (c8).
